'''Haven of Sprouts''' is an area of [[Black Shores Archipelago]], [[The Black Shores]]. As the living quarters of the [[Black Shores]] staff, it is tailored to reflect their tastes. From arcade machines to rare collections from around the world, anything they like can be found here.<ref name="WGV1">Article: [[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1]]</ref>

==Points of Interest==
==="Mysterious Door"===
To make things easier for the staff, the Black Shores has installed access doors for quick travel between locations. But among the staff, a tale about a mysterious door emerges. It is said that passing through the doors in a specific way will lead you to a hidden room filled with rare treasures. Yet some claim that those who enter the room will never find their way back. To this day, the truth remains a mystery.<ref name="WGV1" />

===[[Eye of Asteria]]===
The eye through which the Black Shores gazes upon the stars. It monitors the [[Etheric Sea]] of [[Solaris-3]] from the Black Shores' highest vantage point.<ref name="WGV1" />
